title: ACCORD Provider Definition
description: Connectivity declaration sidecar for a tracker or enrichment provider. Each provider in assets/providers/{trackers,enrichments}/ has a paired <name>.md (fetch playbook) and <name>.json (this schema). User-supplied providers can also be declared inline in accord.json under the providers field.

name.description: Provider identifier. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens. Must match the filename (without extension) for bundled providers.

kind.description: tracker = primary ticket source (one per work item). enrichment = supplementary context source (zero-or-more).

label.description: Human-readable label used in preflight reports.

mcpTools.description: Preferred MCP tool names. Any one match in the agent's available tool set marks the provider as available.

cliFallback.description: CLI binary name (checked via `which`) used when no MCP tool is available.

envFallback.description: Environment variable that, when set, enables an HTTP/API fallback fetch path.

promptFile.description: Path to the fetch playbook markdown file. For bundled providers this is a sibling filename (e.g. "jira.md"). For user-supplied providers in accord.json this can be an absolute or tilde-prefixed path.
